name: Princess Harem
source:
You're the prince of a certain kingdom, and one day, three princesses from different kingdoms come to wed you.

Charo, a sexually experienced slut who is eager to use you.
Flora, a pure and prideful princess knight who will do anything for her kingdom.
Azur, a stubborn girl with eyes for another man, who rejects you.

It's your job to corrupt these princesses into love slaves with your magic touch!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ280657.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你是某个王国的王子。某天，来自不同王国的三位公主前来与你成婚。

查罗是一位经验丰富、急于利用你的荡妇；弗洛拉是一位纯洁高傲的公主骑士，愿为王国赴汤蹈火；阿祖尔则是个固执的女孩，心有所属，并拒绝了你。

你的任务是用自己的魔法触碰她们，让这些公主堕落为爱之奴隶！[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ280657.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
